scenes.title: Stevin Structural Testing Hall
scenes.institution: Delft University of Technology — Macrolab / Stevinlaboratory structural test hall
scenes.reference_notes: Official hall photograph shows long white concrete beam specimens passing through large blue bolted steel loading frames. Supported hydraulic cylinders contact the beams; many surface sensor leads feed local acquisition desks. Tripod cameras and yellow/red movable barriers border the test area; red fixture frames stand along the back wall. High glazing, an overhead crane beam and an upper gallery establish the industrial hall context. Photo identifies a particular structural-test setup, not the permanent placement of every hall fixture. Exact beam dimensions, hidden doorways, specimen reinforcement and damage state are not measured. A reconstruction may support fixture access and sample positioning; concrete fracture and structural response require separate validated models. Image CDN is embedded by the official university page.

scenes.title: Robotic Fabrication Gantry Hall
scenes.institution: ETH Zurich — Robotic Fabrication Laboratory at Arch_Tec_Lab
scenes.reference_notes: Official photograph identifies the Robotic Fabrication Laboratory and shows multiple industrial manipulators hanging from tall gantry carriages. White overhead rail frames and vertical lift members support the robot bases; cable chains follow the travel axes. Double-height work floor is surrounded by upper glazed rooms, a rear staircase and full-height side windows; yellow safety posts mark the work zone. The photograph documents real installed hardware but not a running fabrication sequence. Gantry span, robot models, control performance and hidden hall boundaries require further evidence. No structural fabrication or material-process validation is implied.

scenes.title: Mougel Inorganic Chemistry Glovebox Aisle

scenes.reference_notes: Viewed a working aisle lined by large glazed glovebox fronts on the right, projecting black glove sleeves, opposing enclosures, tiled floor, tall support frames and overhead linear lights. Windows terminate the long aisle; stools and antechamber hardware are visible. This is actual installed apparatus, not a product render. Only the glovebox aisle is established by this image; other devices listed in the tour belong to separate views and must not be assumed adjacent.

scenes.title: FloWave Circular Ocean Research Basin
scenes.institution: The University of Edinburgh — FloWave Ocean Energy Research Facility
scenes.reference_notes: Viewed an operating circular basin with a ring of vertical wavemaker panels, a grated perimeter deck, yellow edge services/rails and dark truss structures. A large yellow bridge crane spans the high steel-truss hall. The central wave confirms experimental operation; it is not evidence of a fluid solver in our future model. Published basin diameter/depth are available, but hall plan, paddle count and measurement-system arrangement require further evidence. No wave/fluid dynamics implementation is implied.
